title: Beijing to Shanghai: 1,318 km in 4.5 Hours at 350 km/h | China Travel Expert
description:
Skip the flight — China's flagship bullet train links its two biggest cities in an afternoon.

The Beijing–Shanghai high-speed line (the Jinghu railway) runs 1,318 km and opened in 2011. Fuxing trains cruise at 350 km/h, and the fastest service does the whole trip in about 4 hours 18 minutes — city-center to city-center, no airport. The best part is what's in between: hop off at Qufu, the hometown of Confucius, or stop in Nanjing to walk its 600-year-old Ming city wall. It's a route, not just a ride.

🧭 Expert Tip: Book on the official 12306 app or Trip.com a few days ahead — the fastest trains and the roomy business-class seats sell out first.
